title: Pay $60 to unlock $480
scenario: A remote-work app shows you earned $480 from simple rating tasks. To withdraw it, the app says your account is “negative” and you must deposit $60 in crypto to complete the final task set.

answers.A: Do not deposit more money; stop and report the platform/contact.
answers.B: Try to withdraw without paying and preserve screenshots/evidence for your bank or reporting agency.
answers.C: Deposit the $60 because the app already paid you a small amount earlier and the visible balance is much larger.

explanation: Task scams use fake balances and sometimes real small payouts to make later deposits feel logical.
proTip: Never pay money to unlock wages.
